parts.text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
No, go ahead. Are you here for Professor Lee's lecture too?
Yes. The poster says nine o'clock, but the notice on the door says half past nine.
Right — they changed the room, so the lecture was pushed back by thirty minutes.
Good thing I checked. Otherwise I would have waited outside for half an hour.
